title: tiny pocket knife
text: tiny pocket knife. I purchased this to attach to my key fob - It is perfectly tiny.  I use it for opening face mask bags or anything that needs a tiny start.  Works PERFECTLY and it's SHARP.  I love it.  It's not for much else  because the blade is literally so short.  On the other hand it's exactly what I wanted.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
